statusDescription.pending: The task has been created and is waiting for scheduling or background execution.
statusDescription.preparing: Allocating GPU resources, loading datasets, and initializing the model.
statusDescription.running: The training loop is actively running and metrics should keep updating.
statusDescription.stopping: A stop request was accepted and the worker is shutting down safely. This task cannot be changed or deleted yet.
statusDescription.recovering: The service is reconciling an interrupted generation attempt. This task cannot be changed or deleted yet.
statusDescription.publishing: The generated dataset is being registered and linked. This final step cannot be stopped or deleted.
statusDescription.evaluating: Training is done and final evaluation metrics are being computed.
statusDescription.restarting: The service is restarting or reloading and should recover shortly.
statusDescription.syncing: Incremental data is being fetched from the external system.
statusDescription.generating: The generation pipeline has been triggered and is writing artifacts.
statusDescription.loading_adapter: The latest adapter is being loaded into the online inference instance.
statusDescription.registered: The record exists, but the dataset content is not fully ready yet.
statusDescription.uploading: The dataset is being uploaded to backend storage before it can be used.
statusDescription.downloading: The backend is downloading dataset files from an external source.
statusDescription.processing: The system is parsing, validating, or transforming dataset content.
statusDescription.ready: The dataset is ready for training, evaluation, preview, or export.
statusDescription.error: An error occurred while processing the dataset and requires attention.
statusDescription.stopped: The task has been stopped and will not continue until resumed or restarted.
statusDescription.cancelled: The task was cancelled before it started.
statusDescription.available: The resource is ready to be consumed by training, deployment, or retrieval.
statusDescription.healthy: The service passed health checks and should respond normally.
statusDescription.unhealthy: The service failed health checks and may not serve requests reliably.
statusDescription.unknown: There is not enough health information yet to determine service state.
statusDescription.archived: The resource is archived and excluded from normal workflows by default.
statusDescription.inactive: The configuration exists but is currently disabled.
statusDescription.idle: The task is idle and waiting for the next trigger.
